node.title: Re^5: Getting the client IP in Apache, version 2.4
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
How did you get that to work?!
Can't locate object method "client_addr" via package "Apache2::Connection"
Apache/2.4.29 (Ubuntu) OpenSSL/1.1.1 mod_apreq2-20090110/2.8.0 mod_perl/2.0.10 Perl/v5.26.1

It's been a very long time since I last worked with mod_perl, but what is strange here is that I can't find a reference to ->client_addr neither [mod://Apache2::Connection|here] nor [https://perl.apache.org/docs/2.0/api/Apache2/Connection.html|here]. Have you tried ->remote_ip instead?
